name: @mnemosyne-plugins/mnemo-parts
description: Open a 3D model you bring (STEP, GLB, glTF, OBJ, STL) and explode it part by part, layer by layer. Factory part codes are decoded into readable names, which you can correct. Write a note on any part, then keep the whole model sheet in your memory so the chat can find it. Works offline; the file stays on your machine.

descriptionI18n.en: Open a 3D model you bring (STEP, GLB, glTF, OBJ, STL) and explode it part by part, layer by layer. Factory part codes are decoded into readable names, which you can correct. Write a note on any part, then keep the whole model sheet in your memory so the chat can find it. Works offline; the file stays on your machine.
descriptionI18n.fr: Ouvrez un modèle 3D que vous apportez (STEP, GLB, glTF, OBJ, STL) et éclatez-le pièce par pièce, couche par couche. Les codes d'usine des pièces sont traduits en noms lisibles, que vous pouvez corriger. Écrivez une note sur une pièce, puis gardez la fiche du modèle dans votre mémoire pour que le chat la retrouve. Fonctionne hors ligne ; le fichier reste sur votre machine.
descriptionI18n.es: Abre un modelo 3D que tú aportas (STEP, GLB, glTF, OBJ, STL) y despiézalo pieza a pieza, capa a capa. Los códigos de fábrica de las piezas se traducen en nombres legibles, que puedes corregir. Escribe una nota sobre una pieza y guarda la ficha del modelo en tu memoria para que el chat la encuentre. Funciona sin conexión; el archivo se queda en tu máquina.

agentActions.summary: List the models open in tabs and the ones in the library, and say if a file is being read
List the parts of the model on screen: number, name, factory code, note, hidden or not
agentActions.details: Answers the total and at most limit rows. text filters on the name and the code. namesKept false means names and notes cannot be written yet.

text.description: Words to look for in a part's name or code

limit.description: How many parts to answer, 1 to 500 (100 by default)

agentActions.summary: Select a part, as a click on its row does: it lights up in the 3D model
agentActions.details: Give number (from 1) or part, said as the person says it. Several matches are refused with their numbers (AMBIGUOUS): pick one and call again.

part.description: The part as the person says it (« le roulement », « boulon 2 »), its factory code or its name; give this or number

number.description: The part's number in the list, from 1, as parts lists it

agentActions.summary: Hide a part, show only one part, bring one hidden part back, or show every part again, as the Hide, Isolate and Show all buttons do
agentActions.details: hide, isolate and show act on part, or on the selected part when part is not given; the part is selected first, as with the buttons.

how.description: hide, isolate, show (one hidden part back) or all

part.description: The part as the person says it (« le roulement », « boulon 2 »), its factory code or its name; give this or number

number.description: The part's number in the list, from 1, as parts lists it

agentActions.summary: Open the model part by part, as the slider does, by layers or radially
Give a part a readable name, kept with the model, as typing in the name field does
agentActions.details: Answers once the name is written. Without name, the part goes back to its decoded or factory name. Refused while the model's names are not read.

part.description: The part as the person says it (« le roulement », « boulon 2 »), its factory code or its name; give this or number

number.description: The part's number in the list, from 1, as parts lists it

agentActions.summary: Write a note on a part, kept with the model, as the note field does
agentActions.details: Replaces the part's note; without note, the note is emptied. Answers once it is written.

part.description: The part as the person says it (« le roulement », « boulon 2 »), its factory code or its name; give this or number

number.description: The part's number in the list, from 1, as parts lists it

agentActions.summary: Bring an open model's tab to the front, or reopen a model from the library
agentActions.details: Takes the model as the person says it (« le moteur » for moteur_v2.step), its file name, its path or a tab id. A file only dropped, never picked, cannot be reopened: the person must drop it again. A large file takes seconds; models says when it is open.

model.description: The model as the person says it, its file name, path or tab id

agentActions.summary: Close an open model's tab, as its × does; it stays in the library
agentActions.details: Takes the model as the person says it, its file name or tab id. A model only dropped, never picked, is refused: closed, it would come back only by dropping it again.

model.description: The open model as the person says it, its file name or tab id

agentActions.summary: Show a screen, as the side buttons do: the model, the library of models opened, the sources of free models, or the Sketchfab search
Close the library, the sources or Sketchfab and come back to the model, as the back button does
Type words in the parts list's filter, as the filter field does; without text the whole list comes back
agentActions.details: Answers how many parts the list shows and the first of them.

text.description: Words a part's name or code holds

agentActions.summary: Keep the model sheet (every part's name and note) in this app's memory vault, as the keep button does
agentActions.details: Writes into the app's own sandbox vault so the chat can find it. Answers the vault once written.

agentGuide: Name a part or a model the way the person says it (« le roulement », « le moteur »): Parts finds it by its words, its code or its number. Several matches are refused with their names (AMBIGUOUS): pick one and call again.
To look at something: selectPart lights a part up, showParts hides, isolates or brings parts back, explode opens the model, filterParts narrows the list.
Screens: showView for the model, the library, the sources or Sketchfab; closeView comes back to the model. openModel brings a model to the front or reopens it; closeModel closes its tab.
A part's name or note: renamePart, notePart. To keep the whole sheet in memory: keepSheet.
